title: Get the authorized TikTok account permission scopes via access token
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the permission scopes of a TikTok account that are authorized by the TikTok account user. If you want to get the permission scopes of a TikTok creator account (which is a TikTok Personal Account) authorized by a creator on TikTok Creator Marketplace, see [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-the-authorized-creator-permissions/v1.3). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/token_info/get/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | app_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer application.

You can find the App ID by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |access_token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok accounts.

For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738084387220481#item-link-Obtain%20a%20TikTok%20account%20access%20token).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/token_info/get/' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{ "app_id":"{{app_id}}", "access_token":"{{access_token}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The return code. For the complete list of error codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|The return message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Returned data.| #|app_id |string |ID of your developer application. | #|scope|string|Scope of permissions for the specified access token.
For instance, `"user.info.basic,video.list"`.| #|creator_id|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok Account.

Note: You can pass the value of this field to the parameter `business_id` in [Accounts API](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737944775511041) requests.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "app_id": "{{app_id}}", "creator_id": "{{creator_id}}", "scope": "video.publish,user.info.basic,video.list,user.insights,user.insights.creator,tcm.order.update,comment.list.manage,video.insights,comment.list" } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get TikTok account permission scopes in an access token
seo_description: Use this endpoint to get the permission scopes of a TikTok Business Account or a TikTok Personal Account that are authorized by the TikTok account user.
